images.title: Chikki bars into pieces
images.purpose: Give the method cue for writing a mixed number as a fraction, with the sample 2 3/5: each whole bar is 5 fifths, then add the loose fifths.
images.composition: Two whole bars on the left and three loose pieces on the right with a clear gap, and a count line and equation below.
images.exact_structure: Two identical long flat chikki bars, one above the other, each scored by thin grey #6B7280 lines into exactly 5 equal pieces, filled teal #0072B2. To the right, after a clear gap, exactly 3 loose pieces, each exactly one fifth of a bar, filled amber #E69F00, in a short row. Below, centred: the count line, then the equation in reddish purple #CC79A7. Exactly 2 bars, 13 pieces of one fifth.

images.takeaway: Turn every whole into units, then add the units left over.
images.description: Two teal chikki bars of 5 fifths each and 3 amber loose fifths show 2 3/5; 2 bars = 10 fifths and 10 + 3 = 13 fifths give 2 3/5 = 13/5.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the pieces bar by bar and then the loose ones, saying the total in fifths.

image_decisions.why: A sample of bars split into fifths gives a method cue for all six parts without answering any of them.
